text.en: Pet owners consistently praise trainer Abe for his honest guidance, professional dedication, and genuine passion for working with dogs. Reviewers appreciate his upfront approach, including recommending veterinary consultations prior to training when necessary. Military families also note his helpful flexibility regarding service schedules.

Clients report remarkable behavioural improvements following the two-week board-and-train courses. Dogs that previously pulled on leashes, ignored commands, or exhibited stubborn puppy habits returned home well-mannered, attentive, and confident. Many owners emphasize reliable off-leash obedience achieved without constant food bribery.

title.en: Daily video updates and owner guidance

text.en: Pet parents frequently highlight the transparent communication provided throughout boarding programmes. Clients enjoy viewing daily progress videos that show their dogs mastering new skills. In addition, owners value the comprehensive one-on-one handover sessions, where techniques are demonstrated so training continues effectively at home.

q.en: What format does the primary training programme follow?

a.en: The core programme is a two-week board-and-train curriculum where dogs stay on-site and learn off-leash obedience and household manners.

q.en: How are owners kept updated during board-and-train courses?

a.en: The trainer shares regular daily video updates documenting each pet's progress and behaviour throughout the training period.

q.en: Are handover sessions included after completion?

a.en: Yes, client reviews note that the trainer conducts detailed one-on-one sessions with owners upon collection to explain how to maintain good behaviour.

q.en: Does the facility offer payment plan options?

a.en: Yes, reviewers mention that flexible payment plan options are available to help manage training course costs.
